name: Ahmed Yasser
tagline: I build responsive, modern web interfaces with React.js, with clean design, high performance and a smooth user experience.
about: I'm Ahmed, a Frontend Developer from Egypt with strong knowledge of modern web development technologies. I build responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React.js, and I care a lot about clean design, high performance and a smooth user experience.

I graduated in Management Information Systems in 2024 with a Very Good grade, then joined an intensive Frontend Development training at EraaSoft. There I built multiple real-world projects and worked in a team of 6 developers, where I acted as Team Leader, organizing tasks and coordinating the work with Git and GitHub.

On the back-end side I studied .NET and build Web APIs with C# and ASP.NET Core. This website is an example: its front-end and its API are both built by me. I'm looking for a Frontend or Junior Full-Stack (.NET) role where I can keep learning and build products people enjoy using.
